what_happened: On an open multi-lane highway with the nearest lead more than 50 m away, the policy braked hard for no visible reason, slowing from 15.7 to 6.7 m/s, while edging left toward the adjacent lane next to actor 1. Actor 28, a replayed car that had been following, closed in from behind-right and made contact on the ego's right side and rear at 8.1 s. The cause is phantom braking, not a missed lead or a turn into an actor.
